sourceHierarchy: The current ordinary OL hero page and official announcement agree on the complete rules. The official API supplies identity and portrait, not execution details.
Canonical public client records match this ordinary variant. Script selectors and exact entity tags are public-client observations, not authenticated server-rule traces.

The OL 大乔 account reposts named player-authored guides. These same-product guides explain hand residency, direct or converted genuine Use, Equipment/Discard collection and arbitrary Ending allocation; they are not exclusive FAQs.

scriptClasses.reading: Self is allowed; recipient maximum is current grain count or one when empty. Role data labels individual entities for the actual recipient. Tags do not authenticate a server collection algorithm.
Each grain entity exposes its original native card and admits Use or Played with a once-turn limit. IronChain has its native Use dispatch. This does not convert all grain into Slash or Dodge.
A recipient-at-two selector conflicts with the published arbitrary allocation and same-product guide. It is recorded as UI observation, not imposed as a gameplay cap.

supportedReadings: Setup automatically selects one random real card per category.
Preparation may include self and may be activated with zero grain.
An original drawn entity can remain marked across turns while retained in the original recipient Hand; direct or converted genuine Use can qualify, while mere Played cannot.
Collect only from Equipment or Discard, not delayed cards retained in Judgment.
All three grain can be given to one recipient.

guideInterpretations.displayedDate: 02/05; year not inferred from abbreviated display
supportedReadings: Setup uses random real cards of three different categories.
All grain may be allocated to one recipient; there is no two-card recipient gameplay cap.

implementationInferences.rule: Choose one available real deck entity per Basic, Trick and Equipment category using the deterministic game PRNG. Freeze the invoice before movement children. If a category is absent, do not invent a substitute.
implementationInferences.basis: Official three-category rule plus guide random selection; absent-category fallback is native shortage composition, not a FAQ.

implementationInferences.rule: Freeze X=max(1,current exact source-pile count) and distinct living recipients including self when the optional effect is accepted. Sequentially request one real native draw each. Skip recipients dead before their request; dead issuer or terminal game starts no new draw.
implementationInferences.basis: Published one-card-per-recipient effect combined with native sequential draw and death lifecycle.

implementationInferences.rule: Only NativeDrawOutcome.ActualDrawIds establish a collection lease through actual deck-to-recipient-Hand movements. ReplacementGainedIds are neither rewritten as actual draws nor tagged as Jiyun entities.
implementationInferences.basis: Therefore-drawn means the actual native draw entity; no dedicated replacement FAQ was found.

implementationInferences.rule: Each lease is an exact entity/original-recipient Hand residency with no invented turn expiry. Preserve the first real departure. A qualifying payment must be a true Use by that same final native actor/provider from original Hand. Transfer, recast, unrelated costs and pure Played do not create collection rights.
implementationInferences.basis: Guide continuous-Hand explanation and Use/Played distinction; actor-replacement combinations are implementation inference.

implementationInferences.rule: Collect only after native whole Use or genuine response Use completion, once per action rather than per target or extra effect. Final original entity must be in the native actor Equipment or Discard with exact payment and terminal movement proof. Never take from Hand, Judgment, another pile or unrelated later discard. Genuine Dodge/Nullification Use qualifies; Duel, area and faction-provider Played does not.
implementationInferences.basis: Published completion timing, guide Equipment/Discard examples and native true Use/Played classification.

implementationInferences.rule: Only valid original marked actual-draw entities among true Use materials are candidates; never include unmarked materials. Process multiple marked entities by original lease issue order, await each claim children, then recheck current exact source-pile count<3 per entity. At3, later entities are not collected.
implementationInferences.basis: Explicit entity-object and sequential capacity composition adopted here. No dedicated multi-material/server-wire FAQ was found; a UI count display is not proof that4 is legal.

implementationInferences.rule: Paid Preparation and completed-Use collection retain their exact issued child-return obligations after skill loss. A lost source may retain empty metadata for an issued lease; it is not a permanent warehouse or fresh-use authorization. Ordinary source-loss cleanup removes old grain and unrelated entities. Only an exact active entity already claimed by paid CollectChildren is temporarily retained until its children return, after which ordinary cleanup may remove it. Init/Ending do not preserve old grain. Dead issuer starts no new draw or claim and does not preserve the pile.
implementationInferences.basis: Issued native effects and typed returns are preserved; no dedicated source-loss FAQ or arbitrary whole-pile resurrection is claimed.

implementationInferences.rule: Use or Played preserves exact original grain kind, suit, rank and entity; authorization is not conversion. Natural target, request, range, ban and quota rules apply. A provider shares one successful grain entry per actual turn and actual turn owner across directions and instances. Queries, cancel, failed admission and unconsumed declarations spend nothing. Paid native action continues after losing Shuliang without repaying.
implementationInferences.basis: Published Use-or-Played and once-per-turn wording; cross-instance accounting and late binding are native composition inferences.

implementationInferences.topic: Requests before the first actual turn
implementationInferences.rule: GameStarting and its native child requests run before BeginTurn. If an otherwise legal original-grain request occurs there, successful entries share one opening-window allowance at actual turn zero; the first actual turn receives a fresh allowance. No special prohibition or unlimited-use exception is added.
implementationInferences.basis: Explicit engineering default consistent with existing UsesPerActualTurn accounting and the GameStarting-before-BeginTurn lifecycle. The official per-turn text and client timeLimitRound=1 do not settle this boundary; no dedicated FAQ or natural pregame combination is claimed as runtime-verified.

implementationInferences.rule: Freeze all actual grain entities in currently live authorized Jiyun sources at the accepted first Ending decision. Give any subset through real entity movements and awaited children, to living recipients including self; repeated recipients are allowed. Do not extend the frozen invoice with new grain. No recipient-at-two cap.
implementationInferences.basis: Official arbitrary allocation and guide all-three-to-one example take precedence over conflicting selector-at-two UI. Freeze point and multiple-source composition are inferences.

implementationInferences.rule: Grain is a named public character pile with visible faces. Hand identity/marks follow normal viewer privacy. Custom recipient/allocation choices are private to their decision owner. Receipt collections are deeply read-only, history events scalar, pending state on its owning Program frame.
implementationInferences.basis: Existing public pile, command commit, checkpoint and privacy boundaries; no fake Hand/Ox region or use-ID sidecar.
